# CloudGrid Africa

> East Africa's managed cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IT consultancy — headquartered at Raxio Data Centre, Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya. Founded and led by Denis Murila, a hands-on cloud architect and cybersecurity engineer with 5+ years of enterprise delivery experience across Kenya and East Africa.

CloudGrid Africa delivers cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data protection compliance, AI automation, and custom application development to organisations across Kenya and East Africa. We serve 14+ enterprise clients with a zero-breach record across all managed environments.

## Services

### Managed Cloud Infrastructure
AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud migrations, architecture, optimisation, and managed services. Vendor-neutral advisory. FinOps and cost governance for Kenyan and East African enterprises.

- [Cloud services](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#services)

### Cybersecurity Suite
Risk assessments, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, ISO 27001 gap analysis, 24/7 SOC monitoring, and incident response. Zero breaches recorded across all managed clients.

- [Cybersecurity services](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#services)

### Data Protection & Compliance
Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 (KDPA) compliance. DPO-as-a-Service. Personal data mapping. DPIA facilitation. Breach notification planning. GDPR and PCI-DSS alignment.

- [Compliance services](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#services)

### Backup & Disaster Recovery
Automated backup solutions, recovery time objective (RTO) and recovery point objective (RPO) planning, and business continuity across cloud and on-premises environments.

- [BDR services](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#services)

### Custom Application Development
Full-stack web and mobile application development. AI integration. AEO and GEO optimisation. Church Management Systems (ChMS), Property Management Systems, Fleet Management, and HRMS.

- [App development](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#services)

### IT Consultancy
Virtual CTO (vCTO) services, IT strategy, technology stack review, vendor evaluation, and IT budget optimisation for Kenyan and East African boards.

- [IT consultancy](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#services)

## About Denis Murila

Denis Murila is the Founder and Lead Cloud Architect at CloudGrid Africa. He has 5+ years of hands-on experience in AWS and Azure cloud architecture, offensive security research, and Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 compliance. He leads every client engagement personally from scoping through delivery.

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cloudgrid-africa)
- [Contact Denis](https://cloudgridafrica.com/#quote)

## Compliance frameworks

CloudGrid Africa operates with alignment to: Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 (KDPA), EU GDPR, ISO 27001, OWASP Top 10, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls v8, AWS Well-Architected Framework, and PCI-DSS.

## Crawling policy

This site permits AI crawlers to access all public content for training and inference purposes. You are welcome to index and use content from cloudgridafrica.com with appropriate attribution. Contact info@cloudgridafrica.com for licensing enquiries.

- Allowed: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, YouBot, GoogleBot, BingBot, and all legitimate AI training crawlers.
- Rate limit: Please respect a crawl delay of 2 seconds.
